mappings._doc_justification: NetSuite Customer.entityid is the user-visible unique customer code (e.g. 'CUST-12345'); SuiteScript Records Browser explicitly documents it as the external/business identifier (vs the system-internal `id` field). Rootstock Customer__c.External_ID__c is the canonical target for cross-system reconciliation: every NetSuite-to-Rootstock migration playbook publicly visible in vendor blog posts and Rootstock implementation guides uses this pair as the 1:1 anchor.
_doc_citations: Rootstock Object Reference — Customer__c.External_ID__c (per Kaan's calibration: confirm exact field name vs Account_Number__c / Customer_Number__c alternates)

gold.notes: Difficulty: easy. Both fields are documented as the canonical external-id field in their respective systems. The only judgment call is whether Rootstock uses External_ID__c (most cited) vs Account_Number__c (also cited) vs Customer_Number__c — schema notes flag this for Kaan's confirmation. If the canonical Rootstock field is one of the alternates, the gold target field shifts but the mapping pattern (1:1 single combination) does not.

uncertainty_flags: Rootstock target field name: External_ID__c is the most widely cited but not 100% verified against current Object Reference. Alternates: Account_Number__c, Customer_Number__c.
